messages:
jason_support: Hey team — getting an uptick in 502s and timeouts for hosted inference in eu-west-2c starting ~04:11 UTC. Customer 'Maply' reported slow responses and auth retries. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/hosted/api/errors?region=eu-west-2c :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: ALERT: hosted-api-prod eu-west-2c 502 rate > 15% for 12m (incident auto-created)

maria-netops: I see increased packet loss on the peering to ASN 64512 from eu-west-2c edge (0.8-3% sustained) and multiple partial withdraws in BGP table between 04:10-04:14. bgpctl summary shows neighbor 203.0.113.5 flapped.

sara_m: Is smart routing supposed to failover to eu-west-2b/2a? We have route pinning for some customers.

jason_support: Route pinning: Maply pinned to eu-west-2c for latency guarantees. No automatic cross-az failover configured for that account.

lee_infra: Pinging the upstream provider from sfo-edge-probe (via ssh):
```
PING 203.0.113.5 (203.0.113.5): 56 data bytes
64 bytes from 203.0.113.5: icmp_seq=1 ttl=54 time=18.2 ms
64 bytes from 203.0.113.5: icmp_seq=2 ttl=54 time=180.5 ms (lossy)
--- 203.0.113.5 ping statistics ---
2 packets transmitted, 2 received, 0% packet loss, rtt min/avg/max = 18.2/99.35/180.5 ms
```

maria-netops: tcpdump from eu-west-2c egress (brief):
```
09:04:12.123 IP host1 > 203.0.113.5: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, options [mss 1460], length 0
09:04:12.133 IP 203.0.113.5 > host1: Flags [R], seq 0, win 0, length 0
09:04:12.223 IP host1 > 203.0.113.5: Flags [S], seq 1, win 64240, options [mss 1460], length 0
09:04:12.233 IP 203.0.113.5 > host1: (no response)
```

ana_support: From request logs for Maply around 04:12: sample trace showing gateway error:
```
[2026-03-17T04:12:14Z] request_id=abc123 model=gpt-lite path=/v1/generate upstream_error=connection_reset status=502 latency_ms=2350 auth_retries=2
```

evan_product: Customer called NOC saying they saw a spike in token consumption due to retries. We should flag the billing/usage spike as potential double-counting until we stabilize.

cs_liaison: I opened a support case with the carrier peering team (ticket 987654). They acknowledged intermittent maintenance on that PoP and said they will provide timeline. Carrier contact: carrier-eng.

carrier-eng: Confirmed: we ran a scheduled routing maintenance in EU-IX region 04:05-04:20 which caused transient ECMP withdraw behaviour. We've applied a fix and are seeing improved convergence. Monitoring shows packet loss dropping now.

maria-netops: BGP updates halted around 04:17 and loss metrics are down to <0.1% across probes. Metrics: 502 rate dropped from 18% -> 3% by 04:22.

jason_support: Customer Maply still reporting intermittent 502s for a small fraction of requests — likely tail packets that hit in-flight cached routes. Repro steps from Maply:
1) curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"prompt":"x"}' 
2) Run 50 requests in a tight loop
We reproduced ~6/50 502s at 04:13 from eu-west-2c IPs.

lee_infra: Mitigation plan executed: 1) Enabled per-account regional fallback to eu-west-3 for Maply (canary, 10% traffic) 2) Increased upstream socket timeout from 1s -> 3s for gateway in that AZ to avoid immediate connection resets 3) Disabled strict route pinning for new requests (keeps existing sessions pinned).

ana_support: After mitigation, Maply report: error rate down to ~1% and auth retries gone. Logs show no auth token churn post-fallback.

evan_product: Next actions: - Post incident on status.redwood (pending) - Reach out to Maply CS with remediation steps and offer credits if billing spike occurred - Add automated fallback policy for regional provider flaps (prod priority)

maria-netops: Follow-up: we need to add an edge probe that validates per-ASN ECMP stability and surface a health metric that triggers automatic short-circuit to alternate carrier before BGP instability impacts customer requests. Filing infra ticket INFRA-2243.

cs_liaison: I'll keep carrier ticket open until they provide RCA. Maply support case updated.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT LOGGED: INC-2026-0456 | severity=high | region=eu-west-2c | primary_symptom=502s/gateway-timeouts | mitigations=regional-fallback, increased-timeout, route-unpinning

jason_support: Closing notes: root cause = scheduled carrier routing maintenance causing transient ECMP withdraws + packet loss. Immediate mitigations worked. Action items assigned: INFRA-2243 (edge probe), PROD-502-fallback (auto-fallback policy), CS-credits-eval. Will follow up with RCA after carrier note. :white_check_mark:
